steps.note: Natural cheeses of different types and ages are blended together.

steps.what: emulsifying salts, water, salt and milk fat
steps.note: The emulsifying salts are usually used at no more than 3–4 %, since they bind calcium so the milk protein can hold the fat.
The blend is stirred constantly as it heats, until it is uniform.

steps.name: package
steps.note: The processed cheese is packaged while hot, then cooled and stored at 5–10 °C.
